Arvato Systems.summary_note: Arvato Systems is a credible German IT services company with strong EU jurisdictional foundations — 100% Bertelsmann/Mohn-family/foundation ownership, German law incorporation, ~3,400 EU-based staff, and a robust certification portfolio including BSI C5 Type 2 for its own VPC (December 2025), ISO 27001:2022, and ISO/IEC 22237. Its role as operator of the Delos Cloud for German public administration demonstrates genuine sovereignty engagement at the government level. However, as a systems integrator, Arvato Systems' primary revenue-generating cloud offerings are built on Microsoft Azure (Delos Cloud) and AWS (European Sovereign Cloud), creating clear non-EU technology and legal dependencies throughout its supply chain and software stack. The provider is best characterised as a 'sovereign integrator': it contributes EU-governed operational management and compliance wrappers around US hyperscaler infrastructure. Organisations requiring full independence from non-EU technology should note the material Microsoft and AWS dependencies. Organisations seeking compliant, German-operated managed services with strong BSI C5 and GDPR guarantees will find Arvato Systems a credible choice.
